note: Owner request 28 Nov 2026: clarity, expressive texture, emotion-aware narration themed to the content, with natural pauses and breathing. Applies only to a title whose specs/cast.json has `tone` (eav.cast/1 optional fields tone, narration_moods, per character segment emotion); every other title, cast or not, is narrated exactly as before. eav.expressive composes every Parler description from this table: only the pace, expressivity, atmosphere and mood/emotion phrases vary, the quality clause is the approved bn_arnav::story wording unchanged. Edit phrases here (reviewable data), never in code; a change alters the composed descriptions and so the job identity of new jobs only.
quality_clause: The recording is of very high quality, with very clear audio and the speaker's voice sounding very close up, with no background noise.
narrator_template: {speaker} narrates a {atmosphere} story in fluent, natural standard Bengali, in a warm, clear voice with a moderate pitch and {expressivity} intonation, {mood}, at a {pace} pace. {quality}
character_template: {speaker} speaks in fluent, natural standard Bengali in a {emotion} conversational tone, with a moderate pitch and {expressivity} intonation, at a {pace} pace. {quality}

surprise.phrase: with a tone of quiet surprise

disgust.phrase: with a tone of cold disgust

pauses.note: Silence (room tone) after each voice unit, in ms, by the unit's end. A unit takes the largest structural rule that applies (heading > scene > paragraph > sentence end > clause split); a sentence end is classed by its last mark after closing quotes/brackets are set aside. +dialogue_extra_ms where the voice changes across the unit boundary (into, out of or between speech). Then a deterministic jitter of +/- jitter_fraction seeded by the unit key (sha256), so the rhythm is not mechanical. No pause follows the last unit of a track.

segment_gaps.note: Inside a joined unit, the room tone between two segments (narrator and character, or two speakers): punctuated_ms when the left segment ends or the right one starts with punctuation, else unpunctuated_ms.

room_tone.note: Every pause of an expressive title (between units in film and bundle-audio chapter assembly, between segments in narration_join) is a soft room-tone bed instead of digital silence: deterministic noise (splitmix64 of the sample index, seeded per gap from the unit key), smoothed with a Hann kernel of smooth_ms, scaled to dbfs RMS, with fade_ms raised-cosine fades in and out.
